visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A human hand, visible from the wrist down, holds a large, elongated blue plush toy decorated with Japanese-style illustrations of bamboo, a sunset, and traditional figures. Behind the toy, a tabby cat sits attentively on a light-colored pet bed in a bright, sunlit indoor room with neutral walls. (2) The scene shifts to the tabby cat lying down and rubbing its cheek and head affectionately against the blue plush toy. The lighting is soft and natural, coming from a nearby window. (3) The tabby cat sits upright on the white cushion, looking directly at the camera with a calm, wide-eyed expression while leaning its body against the blue toy. (4) A white cat with black markings on its head sniffs a long, furry, brown tail-like toy held by a hand on a wooden floor. A large glass window in the background reveals green trees and parked white cars outside. (5) The white cat energetically pounces on the furry toy on the floor, rolling its body and using its paws to grab it. (6) A hand tosses a plush carrot and a plush eggplant toward the white cat, which playfully bats at them. (7) A calico cat walks toward the camera across the wooden floor and then flops onto its side next to a red apple-shaped plush toy. (8) An orange and white cat lies on a purple foam puzzle mat, hugging and biting a green and brown plush crocodile toy with great intensity. (9) The orange and white cat continues to roll and play with the crocodile toy as several text overlays appear on the screen.
